Visual-only rebuilding of existing results. No model is fitted. Run from the
repository root, with an explicit new output directory:

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh manuscript/supplementary_publication_figures.qmd NEW_OUTPUT
```

Five existing source tables are copied byte-for-byte. The additional library,
interaction and MAG inputs are hash-recorded; deterministic interaction context
selection matches the historical builder. The complete display-point tables are
saved for verification. Native 180 mm layouts are provisional editorial sizes,
not journal acceptance. Read and debug the following chunks in order.

## Inputs and shared layout

```{r}
#| label: inputs-and-layout
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)})
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(args) == 1L, file.exists("R/figure_style.R"))
out <- args[[1L]]
if (file.exists(out)) stop("Refusing to overwrite an output directory")
dir.create(file.path(out, "figures"), recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(out, "tables"))
dir.create(file.path(out, "source"))
source("R/figure_style.R")
derived <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
baseline <- file.path(derived, "manuscript_figure_candidates/tables")
de <- file.path(derived, "full_transcriptome_de/tables")
frozen_names <- c("supplementary_model_diagnostics.tsv", "supplementary_interaction_feature_counts.tsv",
                  "supplementary_functional_coefficients.tsv", "supplementary_mag_coherence_counts.tsv",
                  "supplementary_population_genomics_cells.tsv")
paths <- c(setNames(file.path(baseline, frozen_names), frozen_names),
           libraries = file.path(de, "library_sizes_and_normalization.tsv"),
           interaction = file.path(de, "de_condition_cycle_interaction_coefficients.tsv"),
           omnibus = file.path(de, "de_condition_cycle_interaction_omnibus.tsv"),
           mag = file.path(derived, "full_de_interpretation/tables/mag_coherence.tsv"))
stopifnot(all(file.exists(paths)))
stopifnot(all(file.copy(paths[frozen_names], file.path(out, "tables", frozen_names))))
frozen <- lapply(paths[frozen_names], fread)
sample_levels <- c("C I1", "C I2", "C I3", "C BF1", "C BF2", "C BF3",
                   "P I1", "P I2", "P I3", "P BF1", "P BF2", "P BF3")
coefficient_labels <- c(condition_adjusted = "Adjusted condition", cycle2_interaction = "Cycle 2 interaction",
                        cycle3_interaction = "Cycle 3 interaction", condition_cycle_omnibus = "Interaction omnibus")
condition_values <- c(Control = phage_uv_condition_colours[["control"]],
                      `Phage-UV` = phage_uv_condition_colours[["treatment"]])
pub <- theme_phage_uv(base_size = 7.5) + theme(
  axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5), axis.title = element_text(size = 7.5),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 6.5), legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 7), plot.tag = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
  plot.margin = margin(5, 6, 5, 5), legend.position = "bottom")
device <- function(filename, width, height, ...) {
  if (isTRUE(capabilities("aqua"))) grDevices::quartz(type = "pdf", file = filename, width = width, height = height, ...)
  else grDevices::pdf(file = filename, width = width, height = height, ...)
}
save_figure <- function(name, plot, height) {
  p <- file.path(out, "figures", name)
  ggsave(p, plot, width = 180/25.4, height = height/25.4, device = device)
  stopifnot(file.exists(p), file.info(p)$size > 0)
}
context_sample <- function(x) x[unique(round(seq(1, nrow(x), length.out = min(20000L, nrow(x)))))]
```

## S1: library and model diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: s1-diagnostics
d <- copy(frozen[["supplementary_model_diagnostics.tsv"]])
filter <- d[panel == "filtering"]
filter[, item := factor(item, levels = c("Retained", "Input"))]
a <- ggplot(filter, aes(median, item)) + geom_col(fill = "#777777", width = .6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(median, big.mark = ",")), hjust = -.1, size = 2.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M"),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .35))) + labs(x = "Features", y = NULL, tag = "A") + pub
libraries <- fread(paths[["libraries"]])
stopifnot(nrow(libraries) == 12L)
libraries[, sample_short := factor(paste0(ifelse(condition == "control", "C ", "P "),
  ifelse(phase == "initial", "I", "BF"), cycle), levels = sample_levels)]
libraries[, condition_label := factor(ifelse(condition == "control", "Control", "Phage-UV"), levels = names(condition_values))]
libraries[, phase := factor(phase, levels = c("initial", "backflush"))]
b <- ggplot(libraries, aes(sample_short)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = sample_short, y = retained_library_size_after_filtering/1e6,
                   yend = effective_library_size/1e6), colour = "#AAAAAA", linewidth = .4) +
  geom_point(aes(y = retained_library_size_after_filtering/1e6), shape = 1, size = 1.8, colour = "#777777") +
  geom_point(aes(y = effective_library_size/1e6, fill = condition_label, shape = phase),
             size = 2.3, colour = "#222222", stroke = .4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_values, name = "Membrane") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(initial = 21, backflush = 24), breaks = c("initial", "backflush"),
                     labels = c("Initial", "Backflush"), name = "Phase") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Library size (millions)", tag = "B") + pub + theme(legend.box = "vertical")
disp <- d[panel == "dispersion"]
disp[, model := factor(sub(":.*", "", item), levels = c("Adjusted condition", "Condition x cycle"))]
disp[, metric := factor(sub(".*: ", "", item), levels = c("Trended dispersion", "Tagwise dispersion", "QL posterior variance"))]
c <- ggplot(disp, aes(model, median, ymin = q25, ymax = q75)) +
  geom_errorbar(width = .16, colour = "#555555", linewidth = .5) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 2.5) + facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Adjusted condition" = "Adjusted\ncondition", "Condition x cycle" = "Condition x\ncycle")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Median and interquartile range", tag = "C") + pub
save_figure("supplementary-model-diagnostics.pdf", wrap_elements(full = (a | b) + plot_layout(widths = c(.7, 1.3))) / c, 165)
fwrite(libraries, file.path(out, "tables/s1_library_display.tsv"), sep = "\t")
```

## S2: complete-universe interaction landscapes

```{r}
#| label: s2-interactions
interaction <- fread(paths[["interaction"]], select = c("feature_id", "coefficient", "logFC", "logCPM", "FDR"))
interaction[, coefficient_label := factor(ifelse(grepl("cycle2", coefficient), "Cycle 2 interaction", "Cycle 3 interaction"),
                                          levels = coefficient_labels[2:3])]
counts <- interaction[, .(tested_features = .N, supported_features = sum(FDR < .05),
                          supported_abs_logFC_1 = sum(FDR < .05 & abs(logFC) >= 1)), by = coefficient]
ip <- rbindlist(lapply(split(interaction, interaction$coefficient), function(x)
  rbindlist(list(context_sample(x[FDR >= .05])[, display_class := "Context"],
                x[FDR < .05][, display_class := "BH FDR < 0.05"]))))
counts[, coefficient_label := ifelse(grepl("cycle2", coefficient), "Cycle 2 interaction", "Cycle 3 interaction")]
a <- ggplot(ip, aes(logCPM, logFC)) +
  geom_point(data = ip[display_class == "Context"], shape = 1, colour = "#A8A8A8", size = .45, stroke = .2, alpha = .35) +
  geom_point(data = ip[display_class != "Context"], shape = 16, colour = "#222222", size = .75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#555555", linewidth = .3) +
  facet_wrap(~coefficient_label, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_text(data = counts, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf("%s at BH FDR < 0.05", supported_features)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.3, size = 2.3) +
  labs(x = "Average log2 CPM", y = "Interaction log2 fold-change", tag = "A") + pub
omnibus <- fread(paths[["omnibus"]], select = c("feature_id", "logCPM", "FDR"))
omnibus[, supported := FDR < .05]
op <- rbindlist(list(context_sample(omnibus[supported == FALSE])[, display_class := "Context"],
                     omnibus[supported == TRUE][, display_class := "BH FDR < 0.05"]))
b <- ggplot(op, aes(logCPM, -log10(pmax(FDR, .Machine$double.xmin)))) +
  geom_point(data = op[display_class == "Context"], shape = 1, colour = "#A8A8A8", size = .45, stroke = .2, alpha = .35) +
  geom_point(data = op[display_class != "Context"], shape = 16, colour = "#222222", size = .7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(.05), colour = "#777777", linewidth = .3, linetype = "dotted") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf("%s at BH FDR < 0.05", sum(omnibus$supported)),
           hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.3, size = 2.3) +
  labs(x = "Average log2 CPM", y = "-log10(BH FDR)", tag = "B") + pub
recomputed_counts <- rbindlist(list(counts[, !"coefficient_label"], data.table(coefficient = "condition_cycle_omnibus",
  tested_features = nrow(omnibus), supported_features = sum(omnibus$supported), supported_abs_logFC_1 = NA_integer_)))
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(recomputed_counts, frozen[["supplementary_interaction_feature_counts.tsv"]], check.attributes = FALSE)))
save_figure("supplementary-cycle-interaction-landscape.pdf", a / b, 175)
fwrite(ip, file.path(out, "tables/s2_interaction_display.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(op, file.path(out, "tables/s2_omnibus_display.tsv"), sep = "\t")
```

## S3: all functional coefficients

```{r}
#| label: s3-functional
functional <- copy(frozen[["supplementary_functional_coefficients.tsv"]])
functional[, coefficient_label := factor(coefficient_label, levels = coefficient_labels)]
functional[, label := factor(label, levels = rev(unique(functional[order(tier, set_id), label])))]
p <- ggplot(functional, aes(signed_log10_fdr, label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#555555", linewidth = .3) +
  geom_point(data = functional[supported == FALSE], aes(colour = set_id), shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 2.4, stroke = .65) +
  geom_point(data = functional[supported == TRUE], aes(fill = set_id, colour = set_id), shape = 21, size = 2.6) +
  geom_text(data = functional[supported == TRUE], aes(label = sprintf("FDR = %.2g", FDR)), hjust = -0.12, size = 2.3) +
  facet_wrap(~coefficient_label, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = phage_uv_signature_colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phage_uv_signature_colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(.08, .35))) +
  labs(x = "Signed -log10(BH FDR)\nOmnibus values are non-directional and positive", y = NULL) + pub
save_figure("supplementary-functional-coefficients.pdf", p, 240)
```

## S4: MAG coherence

```{r}
#| label: s4-mag-coherence
mag_counts <- copy(frozen[["supplementary_mag_coherence_counts.tsv"]])
mag_counts[, coefficient_label := factor(coefficient_label, levels = coefficient_labels[1:3])]
mag_counts[, direction_label := factor(direction_label, levels = c("Down-ranked", "Up-ranked"))]
mag <- fread(paths[["mag"]])[eligible == TRUE]
mag[, supported := FDR < .05]
mag[, coefficient_label := factor(coefficient_labels[coefficient], levels = coefficient_labels[1:3])]
check_counts <- mag[supported == TRUE, .(MAGs = .N), by = .(coefficient, Direction)]
expected_counts <- mag_counts[, .(coefficient, Direction, MAGs)]
setorder(check_counts, coefficient, Direction); setorder(expected_counts, coefficient, Direction)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(check_counts, expected_counts, check.attributes = FALSE)))
a <- ggplot(mag_counts, aes(coefficient_label, MAGs, fill = direction_label)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(.72), width = .64, colour = "#222222", linewidth = .25) +
  geom_text(aes(label = MAGs), position = position_dodge(.72), vjust = -.35, size = 2.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Down-ranked" = "#666666", "Up-ranked" = "#B9B9B9"), name = "Rank direction") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .15))) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Supported MAGs", tag = "A") + pub
b <- ggplot(mag, aes(median_logFC, -log10(pmax(FDR, .Machine$double.xmin)))) +
  geom_point(data = mag[supported == FALSE], shape = 1, colour = "#9A9A9A", size = 1, stroke = .4, alpha = .65) +
  geom_point(data = mag[supported == TRUE], shape = 16, colour = "#222222", size = 1.1, alpha = .72) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#777777", linewidth = .3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(.05), colour = "#777777", linewidth = .3, linetype = "dotted") +
  facet_wrap(~coefficient_label, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Median gene-level log2 fold-change", y = "-log10(BH FDR)", tag = "B") + pub
save_figure("supplementary-mag-coherence.pdf", a / b, 170)
fwrite(mag, file.path(out, "tables/s4_mag_display.tsv"), sep = "\t")
```

## S5: all five population-genomic matrices

```{r}
#| label: s5-population-matrices
pair <- copy(frozen[["supplementary_population_genomics_cells.tsv"]])
pair[, panel_label := factor(panel_label, levels = unique(panel_label))]
pair[, sample_x := factor(sample_x, levels = sample_levels)]
pair[, sample_y := factor(sample_y, levels = rev(sample_levels))]
p <- ggplot(pair, aes(sample_x, sample_y)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = consensus_differences_per_mbp), colour = "white", linewidth = .2) +
  geom_tile(data = pair[diagonal == TRUE], fill = "white", colour = "#D0D0D0", linewidth = .2) +
  facet_wrap(~panel_label, ncol = 2, labeller = labeller(panel_label = function(x) sub(" - ", "\n", x, fixed = TRUE))) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#F7FBFF", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#084594"), trans = "log10",
                       na.value = "#EAEAEA", name = "Consensus differences\nper callable Mbp") +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(display = "rectangles", nbin = 100)) + coord_equal() + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + pub +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = .5, size = 6.5),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank(), legend.key.width = grid::unit(12, "mm"))
save_figure("supplementary-population-genomics.pdf", p, 245)
```

## Provenance and checksums

```{r}
#| label: provenance-and-checksums
notebook <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH"), mustWork = TRUE)
stopifnot(file.copy(notebook, file.path(out, "source/supplementary_publication_figures.qmd")))
fwrite(data.table(input = names(paths), path = unname(paths), bytes = file.info(paths)$size,
                 md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(paths))), file.path(out, "tables/publication_input_provenance.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(data.table(figure = paste0("S", 1:5), width_mm = 180, height_mm = c(165, 175, 240, 170, 245),
                 models_refitted = FALSE, minimum_text_pt = 6.5, source_notebook = notebook,
                 source_notebook_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(notebook))),
       file.path(out, "tables/publication_layout_metadata.tsv"), sep = "\t")
files <- sort(list.files(out, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE))
fwrite(data.table(path = substring(files, nchar(out) + 2L), bytes = file.info(files)$size,
                 md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(files))), file.path(out, "output_checksums.md5.tsv"), sep = "\t")
cat(sprintf("Created five supplementary publication-size candidates in %s\n", out))
```
